title: Battery Client Pilot v1
objective: 1 real manufacturer → 1 battery model → real data → ~10 serial units → DPP + QR → physical UAT → willingness to pay
rule: Do not claim regulatory compliance or certification from technical-pilot evidence alone.

steps.title: Core technical E2E
steps.detail: Google login → company tenant → onboarding → Product/SKU → Batch → 10 serial units → 10 DPP → QR print → phone scan → same DPP update → same QR shows updated public record.
steps.evidence: BAT-EV-001 / BAT-SF000010; capacity update to 101 Ah; public passport remains ACTIVE TECHNICAL PILOT.

steps.title: Hardening + clean rerun
steps.detail: Close current CI/U07/tenant/UI consistency issues, then repeat the entire flow with a fresh test account/company without manual database repair.
steps.evidence: Stage 4/5 + Steps 18/19/20 + Cross-browser are green on current head; U07 determinism still needs closure.

steps.title: Real client intake
steps.detail: Create the real customer tenant, capture company roles, product scope, systems, files, data responsibility and pilot success criteria.

steps.title: Real battery model + units
steps.detail: Load customer-approved model data, create one real battery model and approximately 10 serialized units/passports with physical QR carriers.

steps.title: Customer UAT
steps.detail: Customer scans, verifies, updates and signs off that the DPP flow works for their operational process.

steps.title: Commercial conversion + core freeze
steps.detail: Confirm willingness to pay / commercial next step, freeze Battery v1 core, then continue the remaining canonical master plan in priority order.
steps.evidence: Requires successful UAT and commercial decision.
